policy: Do not use a candidate date as an award-relative clock until the original agreement/effective-date semantics are reconciled. Amounts in the retained reports remain calendar-quarter source snapshots.

records.note: These are differently labeled HUD dates; whether the 2015 obligation is the initial agreement or a later action is not established. The earlier Q20 assignment for 2018Q4 is suspended pending the signed original agreement.

unclassified_qpr_reports.numerator_basis: QPR Total Funds Expended, To Date (includes reported program income where applicable)
unclassified_qpr_reports.vintage_policy: Historical reporting-period values in this specific later-published/revised QPR. Not the contemporaneously available information set and not F31 cumulative sums.
unclassified_qpr_reports.allocation_basis: Whole-grant historical allocation not independently established; overall programmed budget is not total grant award
unclassified_qpr_reports.geography_role: Whole administering grant; not beneficiary allocation
unclassified_qpr_reports.note: Financial amounts retain their reported calendar quarter; no Q4/Q12/Q20 assignment until the two HUD date labels are reconciled.

unclassified_qpr_activities.numerator_basis: QPR Total Funds Expended, To Date (includes reported program income where applicable)
unclassified_qpr_activities.vintage_policy: Historical reporting-period values in this specific later-published/revised QPR. Not the contemporaneously available information set and not F31 cumulative sums.
unclassified_qpr_activities.category_rule: Exact QPR category text to published 16-category crosswalk
unclassified_qpr_activities.geography_role: Original activity in administering grant; responsible-government identity is not beneficiary geography
unclassified_qpr_activities.responsible_identity_basis: Exact F31 activity-key association at that source snapshot, not certified historical QPR responsibility or beneficiary geography
unclassified_qpr_activities.allocation_basis: Reported allocated activity budget: QPR Total Budget, To Date; includes program income where applicable; revised at this reporting vintage. Not original total grant award, all-source projected cost or beneficiary-city allocation.
unclassified_qpr_activities.note: Financial amounts retain their reported calendar quarter; no Q4/Q12/Q20 assignment until the two HUD date labels are reconciled.

records.note: The OIG narrative identifies Minot and the 2012 $67.5 million award but does not print this grant ID in the passage. HUD and city signatures fall in different quarters; the signed agreement and effective-date rule are still needed. Neither date is used as a clock.
